text:
ryan: Heads-up — deploy-bot just auto-pinned runtime v3.2.1 for model-group:quant in eu-west canary because a subset of infra hit a kernel mismatch on arm64. Holding any unpin for now. cc @maya @anita :warning:

maya: Can you paste the deploy-bot log excerpt? Curious which kernel path failed (AVX2 vs NEON).

ryan: paste from deploy-bot:
```
deploy-bot: pin runtime v3.2.1 -> model-group:quant (region=eu-west)
reason: kernel_heuristic_mismatch
affected_nodes: 3/240 (arm64)
error: kernel_lookup failed for tag 'neon-quant-v2' -> fallback attempted
```

maya: Ok that looks like the arm64 quant kernel wasn't found for v3.2.1 image tag. Does this block hosted fallback?

ryan: Hosted endpoints will route to compatible variants automatically, but Dedicated pools in eu-west that pinned to the new image will see degraded capacity for arm64-backed jobs. So yes — this blocks unpin for Dedicated customers using that pool.

anita: Recommend we delay global unpin until the arm64 build/artifact is available. Proposal: hold unpin for 2h or until CI artifact `runtime-v3.2.1-arm64-quant` is uploaded and smoke-tested. If errors exceed 5% in the canary for 15m we rollback to v3.1.9.

jordan: Also flag in the release notes and changelog: runtime v3.2.1 introduces new async KV API that requires SDK >= 2.8. Need an entry so customers using pinned SDKs aren't surprised.

maya: Can we run a targeted rebuild now? Who owns the arm build pipeline? @anita?

anita: I can kick a rebuild but it might take ~18-25m. Command I will run: `ci-build trigger --artifact runtime-v3.2.1 --arch arm64 --profile quant-kernels`

deploy-bot: automated note — canary rollout window started (region=eu-west, group=quant). Monitoring hooks: latency, error-rate, kv-cache-miss.

ryan: Action plan: 1) hold unpin globally, 2) @anita triggers arm64 rebuild, 3) smoke-test artifact, 4) if CI green, push artifact and lift hold with a targeted unpin in eu-west only, 5) otherwise rollback to v3.1.9 with `deployctl rollback --runtime v3.1.9 --group quant --region eu-west` .

jordan: I'll open a quick PR for release notes and add SDK compatibility callout + migration note for deploy playbooks.

maya: ack — I'll message support to watch dedicated customer queues for any incidents and add an internal banner in Console about a temporary hold on runtime upgrades. :ok_hand:

ryan: Holding unpin. Re-eval at timestamp 3100000025 (30m canary) or earlier if build completes. Please add any rollout telemetry thresholds you'd like to the thread. :mag:
